summary: Implemented a unified single-pass Claude CLI planner for goal creation, replaced goal command planning flow to use it (no Anthropic planner API call), preserved planning blocked/awaiting transitions, added strict shared parse/validation reuse, persisted planner diagnostics artifacts (stdout/stderr/raw/attempt metadata), kept auth-mode env behavior aligned with buildClaudeCodeEnv subscription stripping, exposed --plan-only in CLI wiring, and added targeted tests for unified planner success/blocked/parse-failure plus updated goal command tests. Verified with targeted Vitest runs and a manual plan-only CLI run using a local state dir and temporary claude shim in this sandbox.
